designationHistory.indexText: Established in July 1999 when the former Galeville Army airfield was transferred to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service to protect grassland birds and wintering raptors.

authority.citation: Transfer of surplus federal property, 16 U.S.C. 667b

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Shawangunk Grasslands National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

Federal Register, Dec. 5, 2005 (E5-6818), Shawangunk Grasslands NWR CCP: transfer of the former Galeville airport through the General Services Administration "created the Shawangunk Grasslands NWR in 1999"

review.note: Year confirmed in the FR; month only from FWS.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Shawangunk Grasslands National Wildlife Refuge, which protects 597 acres in Ulster County, NY, was established in July 1999 to support grassland-dependent migratory birds and wintering raptors.

historySource: Refuge About Us pages, fws.gov (draft, pending review)
